items.title: Cintas (CTAS) Nears Q1 Earnings, Is A 6% Discount Enough?
items.summary: Cintas (CTAS) heads into its Q1 2027 earnings release and call on September 23, 2026, with investors watching how upcoming results align with prior revenue growth and recent share performance. Recent trading has been mixed for Cintas, with the share price up 16.3% over the past 90 days but easing 2.5% over the last month, while the 1-year total shareholder return is roughly flat and the 5-year total shareholder return of 115.8% points to strong longer term momentum.
